## Onramp live site check
GET `/webhook/live-check` → JSON report (also runs every 6h; see Executions).

Env (optional): `LIVE_FRONTEND_URL`, `LIVE_API_URL`, `LOCAL_API_URL`.
`N8N_INBOUND_SECRET` must match the backend for the signed-ping checks.
Requires `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto`, `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`.
